_comment: Labels for issue priority triage (ADR-0017). The triage workflow creates any that are missing; it never edits or deletes an existing label. Descriptions stay within GitHub's 100-character limit. Owners map an area to the GitHub login assigned when an issue has no assignee; "*" is the fallback.

sev:critical.description: A model writes the decision, unevidenced sign-off, gate reports a pass it did not run (ADR-0017)

sev:major.description: Bundle state misread, guard or decorrelation off, update breaks an instance, driver crash

sev:minor.description: Wrong behaviour with a workaround, cost or time regression, misleading output (ADR-0017)

sev:trivial.description: Cosmetic, wording, docs, or a test-only gap (ADR-0017)

reach:common.description: A normal cycle with a default or documented configuration triggers it (ADR-0017)

reach:edge.description: Needs an unusual configuration, project, bundle shape, model behaviour or timing

reach:adversarial.description: Only when someone sets it up: hostile tracker text, a leaf acting against its role

area:records.description: Bundle state, briefs, §6/§9 and SUMMARY assembly (architecture 5.1)

area:machine.description: The driver and flow: advancing bundles beat by beat (architecture 5.1)

area:leaves.description: Model CLI invocation, heartbeat, memory caps, sandboxes (architecture 5.1)

area:gates.description: Gates and their evidence, red-green, unverifiable results (ADR-0006)

area:publish.description: Worktrees, draft PRs and tracker sources (architecture 5.1)

area:roles.description: What each leaf is told and may see: prompts and agents (ADR-0005)

area:policies.description: Sizing, auto-iterate, Plan-exit, dependency halts, splitting (architecture 5.1)

area:orchestration.description: Waves, lanes, integration lines, merge and revert (architecture 5.1)

area:act.description: Act index and log, review-finding triage, cleanup, hand-off (architecture 5.1)

area:cli.description: The pdca command, pdca.toml, doctor and the STOP-discipline guard

area:template.description: copier.yml, the Jinja template and copier update (ADR-0007)

area:docs.description: Documentation, the pdca.dev site and design records

area:tests.description: The offline driver suite and the root render suite

priority:P0.description: Drop other work, fix now, block the release (ADR-0017)

priority:P2.description: Next milestone, or whenever it fits (ADR-0017)

needs-triage.description: Severity or reach could not be placed; see the triage comment (ADR-0017)
